# Machines & Cloud

> Machines & Cloud builds an AI front desk for Houston home service companies (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing): a website agent that answers customers 24/7, books the visit, and texts the owner the lead, with human handoff for anything risky. Free 7 day pilot, then $397 per month plus a one-time $1,497 build. Phone answering is an add-on. Founder led, Houston based.
